items.title: Billy Mitchell interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, November 16, 1995
items.q: So everybody wanted to record with us. Just about every singer of the day — King Cole, Johnny Mathis, Ella, Sarah, Tony, Frank, oh and there’s some more in there.

ctx.x: You certainly played behind some great singers over the years, with Tony, and of course earlier on.

All of them. We recorded with everybody. At that time everybody wanted to record with the Basie band because the musicianship was so high and then the band itself was moving, so record companies always wanted to try to put two salable commodities together if they could. So everybody wanted to record with us. Just about every singer of the day — King Cole, Johnny Mathis, Ella, Sarah, Tony, Frank, oh and there’s some more in there. That’s one of the advantages of the job. It really wasn’t that much in salary, but…
And did you get to travel overseas with Basie?
